page.overview:
What is Bnazic Desert?

The Bnazic Desert is a fictional location in the Cthulhu Mythos. It first appeared in H. P. Lovecraft's short story "The Doom That Came to Sarnath".

Bnazic Desert is a desert region in the Dreamlands. The heels of camels from the desert were considered a delicacy in Sarnath. (: "The Doom That Came to Sarnath")
